title: feat(types,plugin-dashboard)!: a dashboard widget's chartConfig type / xAxis / yAxis / series follow the spec retirement on the TS face and the dataset read path (objectui#11315)
body:
Fixes #11315
Clause-②: yes

`@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 gave the dashboard widget its own chart config carrier, `DashboardWidgetChartConfigSchema`, which retires `type`, `xAxis`, `yAxis` and `series` (ADR-0021 · ADR-0049 D2; decision batch #121 item 1). objectui's Zod faces already refused the four by reference. The TypeScript twin still compiled them, and the dashboard's dataset widget still read three of them. This PR brings both into line. The react `ObjectChart` tier, where the spec keeps the four authorable, is unchanged, and it now has a control pin.

## What changed

- **TypeScript twin (`packages/types/src/complex.ts`).** `DashboardWidgetSchema.chartConfig` keeps its index signature. `type`, `xAxis`, `yAxis` and `series` are now typed by reference from the spec's own members, the same way PR objectui#11310 typed `aria`: each is `NonNullable` of `SpecDashboardWidget['chartConfig']`, indexed at the key. Each resolves to the spec's retired-key type, so an authored value is a compile error (TS2322). Only the key names are written here. Whether a key admits a value is the spec's answer, so a key the spec re-opened would compile again with no edit to this member.
- **Dashboard read path (`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx`).** The widget no longer calls `mergeAuthoredPresentation`. It emits the dataset-derived series and category axis as they are, and spreads no authored axes. A comparison overlay no longer copies its primary's merged mark and axis, because there is none. The `combo` entry in `CHART_TYPE_MAP` stays, so a `combo` widget still draws as a combo, and the renderer picks each series' mark. The chrome lowering (`chartConfigPresentation`) is unchanged. `mergeAuthoredPresentation` and its two series types are no longer re-exported from this module. The package index never exported them.
- **`@object-ui/core` (`chart-presentation.ts`): comments only.** The file header now names which keys each carrier may author. It also says that `mergeAuthoredPresentation` has had no production caller since this change. The `chartConfigPresentation` docblock no longer calls `aria` "declared" or "pending objectstack#5175": since 17.5.0 it is a tombstone. Criterion 2 now notes that the spec refuses `chartConfig.type` on this carrier. The function's signature and behaviour are unchanged.
- **Pins.**
  - `packages/types/src/__tests__/chartconfig-structure-retired-11315.test.ts` follows the shape of the `aria` pin. On the TypeScript side, each key is declared, is not `any`, and is the retired-key type (`IsRetiredKeyType`), with `title` as the live control. A `@ts-expect-error` sits on an authored literal for each key, `chartConfig.series` among them, and a legal `{ title, showLegend, colors }` literal is the control. On the Zod side, the twin, `DashboardComponentSchema`, `safeValidateSchema` and `StrictAnyComponentSchema` each refuse every key at `chartConfig.KEY` with `invalid_type` and the spec's own message, read from the spec at run time. A spec-standing case checks both halves of the carrier split: the dashboard carrier refuses the four, and the base `ChartConfigSchema` still admits them.
  - `DatasetWidget.comboPresentation.test.tsx` is re-pinned as the dashboard refusal. A `combo` widget still resolves `combo`. With the retired combo shape authored, the series are byte-identical to the derived ones, no axis is spread, the normalized `yAxes` equal the no-`chartConfig` control, a `bar` widget stays a bar, the chrome still lowers, and the overlays carry no mark.
  - `DatasetWidget.chartConfig.test.tsx`: the REFUSED block now pins all three structure keys as unread. Its header no longer cites `ChartConfigSchema` or "pending objectstack#5175". The incidental `type: 'bar'` (a retired key) is dropped from the fixtures of the LOWERED block.
  - `packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.inlineComboSeries-11315.test.tsx` is new. It renders a real `ObjectChart` with inline rows and counts the recharts marks and axes. An authored `series` draws 1 bar, 1 line and 2 y-axes. An explicit `specType: 'combo'` authoring an area plus a line draws exactly those. The control with no per-series mark draws 2 bars.
- **Changesets.**
  - `@object-ui/types` **minor** (TypeScript break, migration example included).
  - `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` **minor** (rendering break: stored widgets that still carry the keys render the derivation).
  - An empty-frontmatter declaration for `@object-ui/core` (comments) and `@object-ui/plugin-charts` (test only).
  - Two pending changesets this change made false are corrected here. In `4044-chartconfig-aria-tombstone.md`, "every other `chartConfig` key keeps its previous typing" now names the four keys. `10132-dashboard-i18n-declared-not-resolved.md` gains a note that its axis-title point no longer reaches a dashboard, and its series-label aside no longer names `DatasetWidget` as the overriding caller. Both edits are prose corrections to changesets this PR does not own. `check-changeset-overwrite` lists them, report-only.

## Zone 2 measurements (dispatch order)

1. **Reproduced on `origin/main` `5638529e67`.**
   - TypeScript: a probe of four `DashboardWidgetSchema` literals (`chartConfig.series` / `xAxis` / `yAxis` / `type`) plus a live control compiled with `tsc` exit 0. The positive control (`chartConfig.aria`) in the same probe failed with TS2322, so the probe could fail. After this change, the same probe exits 2 with four TS2322s, and the control line still compiles.
   - Reader: `mergeAuthoredPresentation(derived, { series, xAxis, yAxis })` returned `chartType: 'line'`, `yAxis: 'right'`, `axes.xAxis.title` and two `axes.yAxis` entries.
   - Zod: the twin, `DashboardComponentSchema`, `safeValidateSchema` and `StrictAnyComponentSchema` refuse all four at `chartConfig.KEY` with `invalid_type`, and a `{ title }` control parses on all four faces.
2. **Another declared home? None.** The installed 17.5.0 dashboard widget declares `id`, `title`, `description`, `type`, `chartConfig` (appearance only), `colorVariant`, `requiresObject`, `requiresService`, `filter`, `compareTo`, `dataset`, `dimensions`, `values`, `layout`, `options` (`dateGranularity`, `sortBy`, `sortOrder`, `limit` and `stageOrder` declared, `$loose`), `filterBindings` and `suppressWarnings`. Retired as tombstones: `actionUrl`, `actionType`, `actionIcon`, `responsive` and `aria` on the widget, and `aria`, `type`, `xAxis`, `yAxis` and `series` inside `chartConfig`. Nothing declares a per-series mark or a second value axis. The `series` tombstone text says per-series appearance "is not authorable on a dataset-bound widget", and the `yAxis` one says "A second axis is a second measure, not a second axis declaration". The spec's liveness ledger (objectstack `packages/spec/liveness/dashboard.json`, the `series` row) records it as a ruled cost: "The per-series mark type that made a dataset-bound COMBO chart authorable goes with the key". The widget `type` enum still carries `combo`, which this PR keeps rendering. So the dashboard combo presentation retires on this carrier, and nothing was escalated.
3. **Callers of `mergeAuthoredPresentation`.** It had one production caller, `DatasetWidget`, plus that module's own re-export, which no importer used. Two tests also call it directly: `chart-presentation.axisTitleI18n-10132.test.ts` in core and `ChartRenderer.axisTitleLocale-10132.test.tsx` in plugin-charts. The react `ObjectChart` tier never called it. `ObjectChart` hands `schema.series` / `xAxis` / `yAxis` to `ChartRenderer`, and `normalizeChartSchema` reads them there. So the carriers needed no switch, because the caller is the carrier. The dashboard call was removed, the function keeps its signature, and no second copy of the merge logic exists. `plugin-report` calls `mergeAuthoredSeries` (not this function), and `ReportChartSchema.series` is still live, so that path is unchanged.
4. **The TypeScript face.** ⚠️ The dispatch premise that `WIDGET_CHART_STRUCTURE_RETIRED` is importable does not hold. In the installed spec it is a module-private message builder, `(key, carried, instead) => string`. It is absent from the `@objectstack/spec/ui` export list and from every `.d.ts`, so nothing can be read from it. The four keys are therefore typed exactly as PR objectui#11310 typed `aria`: by reference from `SpecDashboardWidget['chartConfig']`, the exported spec type whose members those tombstones build. No local list of retired keys, and no local `never`. Proof: the `@ts-expect-error` pins (they go stale if a key compiles again, see ablation 2) and the legal-literal control.
5. **Combo pin: both routes.** The dashboard file is re-pinned as the refusal, and a new `ObjectChart` control in plugin-charts pins that an authored `series` still draws a combo.

## Verification (union at head `25e43c3259`, after the last commit)

- **Build:** `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/plugin-dashboard^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-charts^...' build` → 12 packages built (the `^...` direction is upstream dependencies). `@object-ui/types` `dist/complex.d.ts` carries the new members.
- **Type-check:** `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/plugin-charts` and `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` all print `type-check: Done`. Each runs `tsc --noEmit` plus `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, and `--listFilesOnly` confirms the new and edited tests are in those programs. Downstream consumers of the narrowed face (`DashboardWidgetSchema` / `DashboardComponentSchema` importers): `@object-ui/sdui-parser`, `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/plugin-designer` print `type-check: Done` against the rebuilt dist. `@object-ui/app-shell` and `examples/schema-catalog` are left to CI. A grep finds no dashboard `chartConfig` key use in either. The control: the same grep does hit app-shell's list-view `chartConfig`, which is a different carrier.
- **Tests:** `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/ packages/core/src/utils/ packages/plugin-dashboard/ packages/plugin-charts/` → `Test Files  653 passed (653)`, `Tests  12268 passed | 15 skipped (12283)` (lock verdict `command-exit 0`).
- **Reverse verification through a consumer:** a temporary `packages/plugin-dashboard/src` file typing a `DashboardWidgetSchema` from `@object-ui/types` (the rebuilt dist) with `chartConfig: { title, series }` → `tsc` exit 2, `TS2322 … is not assignable to type 'undefined'` at `series` only. The file was removed under a trap, and `git status` is clean afterwards.
- **Gates:** `check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`), `check:control-bytes` OK, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (`8 source file(s) of 4 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 3 changeset(s)`), `changeset:check` OK, `check:changeset-claims` (the 10 pending bodies naming touched files were each read; none concerns `chartConfig`), `check:pending-changeset-literals` OK, `check:test-path-roots` OK, `check:vi-mock-specifiers` / `-inherit` / `-override-shape` OK, `type-check:coverage` (43/43), `check:spec-symbols` OK, `check:installed-pin-claims` OK, `check:unreferenced-sources` OK, `check:component-surface-parity` (report-only, no finding on `chartConfig`). `apps/console/src/__tests__/registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` was not run, because no registration input text changed.
- **Lint, narrowed:** the 8 changed TypeScript files were linted with the root config (`eslint --no-inline-config --format json`): 8 files, 0 errors. Warnings per modified file did not rise against the base blobs (`complex.ts` 9 → 9, `DatasetWidget.tsx` 12 → 11, the combo test 13 → 5, the chartConfig test 2 → 2). The new plugin-charts test has 2 `no-explicit-any` warnings, from the recharts mock its siblings use. The config enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move another file's verdict. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` belongs to CI.

### Ablations

Each ablation ran from committed state through `ablation-replace.mjs`. The anchor hit was proven, and each restore was proven by the blob equalling HEAD plus an empty `git diff HEAD`. Every subject is imported by relative source path, so no `dist` was involved.

1. **The merge put back into `DatasetWidget`** (import plus `series: mergeAuthoredPresentation(…).series` and `...mergeAuthoredPresentation(…).axes`). Predicted 7 red, and 7 went red: 5 in the combo file and 2 in the REFUSED block. The other 14 stayed green: the `combo` family, the no-`chartConfig` control, the forwards, and `type` / `aria`.
2. **`series?:` deleted from the TypeScript member** → `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 2. The output had `TS2322` on `seriesTombstoned` and `TS2578` (unused `@ts-expect-error`) on the authored `series` literal.
3. **`normalizeChartSchema` stops reading `series[].type`** (`str(raw.chartType) ?? str(raw.type)` → `str(raw.chartType)`).
   - On the first run, only the bar-plus-line case went red. The explicit-`combo` case stayed green, because a combo's positional default (a bar, then lines) draws the same counts.
   - That case now authors an area and a line. The re-run turned both authored cases red, and the no-mark control stayed green.

## Acceptance notes

- **`mergeAuthoredPresentation` and `axisPresentation` have no production caller now.** They are published exports of `@object-ui/core`. They were kept on purpose: the claim's Clause-② treats the function as staying exported, and deleting it would also rewrite `ChartRenderer.axisTitleLocale-10132.test.tsx` in plugin-charts, which is outside this claim's file surface. The comments in this file say so. Deleting both, and re-homing that render pin onto a chart node that authors its own axes, is the follow-up. Carrier: none.
- **Comments elsewhere that this change makes stale, left alone because they are outside the surface.** Carrier: none.
  - `packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts`: "`DatasetWidget` → `mergeAuthoredPresentation`".
  - `packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`: two places say the dashboard makes the same series merge.
  - `chart-presentation.axisTitleI18n-10132.test.ts`: "`mergeAuthoredPresentation` is what `DatasetWidget` calls".
  - `ChartRenderer.axisTitleLocale-10132.test.tsx`: "the path a dataset-bound surface actually takes".
  - `content/docs/plugins/plugin-charts.mdx`: "the `ChartAxis` a dashboard widget's `chartConfig` uses".
- **Comments stale since 17.5.0 that this change does not touch.** Carrier: none.
  - `DashboardRenderer.tsx` (inline relay): "declared as the spec's full `ChartConfigSchema`", and objectstack#17385 described as still open.
  - `DashboardChart.chartConfig-4044.test.tsx`: "objectstack#17385 owns the precedence … Until it answers".
  - `DatasetWidget.chartConfig.dom.test.tsx`: "pending objectstack#5175".
  - The pending changeset `dashboard-inline-chartconfig-4044.md`, which says the same about `ChartConfigSchema` and objectstack#17385.
  - Per the seat's ruling, these negative pins are corrected only where this PR already edits the file.
- **Observation on a combo with `compareTo`.** Every series now takes the combo's positional mark, overlays included, so an overlay can draw in a different mark from its own measure. Before this change, the same happened to any combo that authored no `series`. This is the ruled cost of the retirement, not a new defect class. No public-entry reading was taken. Carrier: none.
- **Same-day churn:** `origin/main` moved 3 commits since the branch point (objectui#11361, objectui#11359, objectui#11346). None touches this diff's files, and `git merge-tree` is clean, so no merge was needed.
